competitor_analysis.brand_overview: Basecamp markets itself as a calm, organized project management platform for coordinating teams, clients, and company-wide communication.

competitors.name: Asana
competitors.comparison: Likely competes with Basecamp in team task and project coordination.
potential_strengths: May offer more granular task assignment and timeline views than Basecamp.
potential_gaps: Could lack Basecamp's unified all-in-one pricing simplicity.

competitors.name: Trello
competitors.comparison: Likely competes with Basecamp's Card Tables Kanban feature for visual process tracking.
potential_strengths: May provide a simpler card-based interface preferred by small teams.
potential_gaps: May not include the same breadth of built-in client communication tools.

competitors.name: Monday.com
competitors.comparison: Likely competes with Basecamp for companies seeking customizable project workflows.
potential_strengths: May offer more visual workflow automation options than Basecamp.
potential_gaps: Could be more complex to set up than Basecamp's straightforward approach.

Title: Basecamp
Description: Trusted by millions, Basecamp puts everything you need to get work done in one place. It’s the calm, organized way to manage projects, work with clients, and communicate company-wide.
Basecamp
Skip to main content
The famously straightforward, easiest-to-use project management platform.
This is what Basecamp
projects look like
Try Basecamp free
or
Check out more example projects
Hey there—
Tell me if this sounds about right.
Every day you’re juggling people,
projects
, and expectations. There are tasks to do, discussions to have, decisions to make, files to share, deadlines to hit, relationships to manage, and work to deliver.
This all has to happen
somewhere
. But you’ve discovered that spreading everything across different apps, browser tabs, emails, and chats doesn’t work. You need a system.
Unfortunately, most project management systems are bloated, complicated, and confusing. And software that’s hard to use doesn’t get used.
20 years ago we were in the same boat. We needed something capable, but also straightforward, easy, and
reliable
. Nothing fit. So we invented Basecamp, and have been improving it ever since. In software, longevity like this isn’t luck — it’s proof it works. And
in 2026 we released the all-new Basecamp 5
, packing decades of experience into our best version yet.
Today, Basecamp is used across every industry, and nearly a million people, teams, companies, and non-profits worldwide
rely on it daily
for
all sorts of things
. Plus,
it’s famously affordable
— especially for small and medium-sized businesses.
Thanks for checking us out. We invite you to give Basecamp a try. And ultimately, we’d be honored to have you as a customer.
Jason Fried,
jason@basecamp.com
Co-founder & CEO
Take a minute to meet some of our customers
They’re product developers, woodworkers, music industry folks, logistics pros, publishers, event planners, marketers, architects, artists, software designers, brand strategists, educators…
Play this 1-minute video
We asked our customers: “What changed for the better since you switched to Basecamp?”
Simply put, we get more work done, quicker, and better.
Productivity is up. Errors are down. Clients are happier.
Patrick Sheffield, Moore Communications Group
Since using Basecamp, our
communication is drastically better and deadlines are met without drama.
Shannon Kropf, Full Sail University
Info is flowing like water. A lot more transparency. Everyone is on the same page.
No more secrets and blindspots.
Aaron Bingaman, Penn State OEM
I no longer have to wonder whether I’ve asked for something…
Every member of my team is more accountable.
John Drover, Roebothan McKay Marshall
Basecamp makes us tighter as a group.
Basecamp makes it easy to create shared understanding in our company.
Teddy Zetterlund, Lägenhetsbyte
We don’t have to contact each other about every little thing.
When we need to know something, it’s right there.
Kelly Hunter, Chamber Nation
Our church is loving Basecamp.
It’s so easy to use even the 80-year-olds on our committee are using it!
Blake Rider, St. Stephen’s Episcopal Church
It eliminated the need for extra communication and
reduced a lot of miscommunication between my team.
Anthony Clark, Clark Partners Realty Group
Check out over 1,000 more customer testimonials
How about a quick demonstration?
No slides, no sales pitch. Just a real project, clicked through in real time. A wonderful way to get comfortable with Basecamp.
See how Basecamp works

Remember when companies cared about service?
We still do! Staffed by incredible humans, we’re here for you 24/7/365.
Meet Eron, our Head of Technical Ops
Durable infrastructure
Rather than rent cloud hosting, we own and run our hardware across multiple data centers. We specified the hardware, configured (and sometimes invented) the software, and optimized every detail for speed and reliability.
We’ve maintained an industry-leading
99.99% uptime
record for years.
Meet Chase, our Head of Support
Dependable customer service
At most companies, customer service is treated as an afterthought, something to outsource, a place to cut costs. At Basecamp it’s one of our best features.
Our customers consistently rave
